description: This Java source file defines the VisitHandler class, which manages website visit and visitor tracking sessions, including creation, retrieval, and updating of visit and visitor entities. It handles persisting visit data, managing session attributes, and setting cookies for visitors.

classes.name: VisitHandler
classes.description: Handles saving and maintaining visit and visitor information, including creation, retrieval, and updates of visit entities, session management, and visitor cookies.

methods.name: setUserLogin
methods.description: Updates visit and visitor entities in the database with the user login information.

methods.name: getVisitId
methods.description: Retrieves the current visit ID associated with the session.

methods.name: getVisit
methods.description: Retrieves the current visit entity from session or creates a new one if necessary, initializing with request and session data.

methods.name: getVisitor
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a visitor entity based on cookies and session data, managing the visitor cookie in the HTTP response.
